release_notes:
Patch Release - XY Plotter Uniformity, Dynamic Theming, and Advanced Issue Reporting.

New Features:
  - XY Plotter Uniformity: Promoted the XY Plotter window to a QMainWindow, granting standard minimize/maximize/close title bar buttons and theme consistency.
  - Help Action Icons: Wired Copy Diagnostics, Report Issue, and Plot Settings QActions to dynamically update their colors when the theme is toggled.
  - Advanced Bug Reporting: Removed the diagnostics selection checkboxes and enabled full Diagnostic Info, QSettings preferences dump, and RotatingFileHandler log tail by default. Added drag-and-drop file attachments and paste clipboard screenshot support. Active configuration file is now automatically attached to report submissions.
